description: This file defines a custom report class for generating product price list XML reports in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for assembling XML data with product and pricing information.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A class for generating product price list XML reports, inheriting from report_rml.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report of product prices based on provided data, including product categories, prices, and formatting.
